## Featured Production Projects

### 1. APIShield (OWASP API Top 10 Automated Pentester)
- **Live**: https://apishield-pi.vercel.app/
- **Repo**: https://github.com/nyzxis/apishield
- **Stack**: FastAPI, Requests, PostgreSQL/SQLite, React 19, Tailwind v4
- **Overview**: Automated REST pentesting suite auditing BOLA/IDOR, broken authentication, JWT alg=none bypasses, and mass assignment with reproducible cURL commands and executive dossiers.

### 2. MalGuard (AI Malware Detection & PE Forensics)
- **Live**: https://malguard.vercel.app/
- **Repo**: https://github.com/nyzxis/malguard
- **Stack**: Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Pandas, React 19, XAI
- **Overview**: Automated static binary dissector inspecting Windows PE headers, Shannon entropy heatmaps, Win32 API imports, and Random Forest classification without executing untrusted code.

### 3. VulnShield (Automated Web Vulnerability Scanner)
- **Live**: https://vulnshield.vercel.app/
- **Repo**: https://github.com/nyzxis/vulnshield
- **Stack**: FastAPI, BeautifulSoup4, Requests, React 19
- **Overview**: Automated web vulnerability auditor detecting Reflected XSS canary tokens, SQL injection heuristics, security headers (HSTS, CSP), and cookie misconfigurations.

### 4. KeyVault (Zero-Knowledge Password Security Analyzer)
- **Live**: https://pwsec-nyz.vercel.app/
- **Repo**: https://github.com/nyzxis/password-security-analyzer
- **Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, FastAPI, HIBP k-Anonymity API
- **Overview**: Zero-knowledge password entropy calculator and HaveIBeenPwned breach detection using SHA-1 prefix k-Anonymity where no raw passwords ever leave the browser.

### 5. PhishGuard (AI Phishing Detection System)
- **Live**: https://phishingdetector-nyzxis.vercel.app/
- **Repo**: https://github.com/nyzxis/phishing-detector
- **Stack**: Scikit-learn, Flask, React, PostgreSQL
- **Overview**: Dual-vector machine learning threat classifier analyzing malicious URLs and phishing emails using NLP lexical extraction and structural heuristics.

### 6. StudyIt (Productivity & Study Workspace)
- **Live**: https://studyitpi.vercel.app/
- **Repo**: https://github.com/nyzxis/studyit
- **Stack**: Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
- **Overview**: Clean, distraction-free study desk with Pomodoro timer, ambient soundscapes, scratchpad notes, and subject progress tracking.
